Job Description: At TTI, people come for the opportunity and stay for the culture!

**Job Description:**

**Graphic Designer – TTI CANADA INC.**

*Full\-Time \| Co\-op*

**TTI is where culture meets opportunity**. We are fast paced, highly energetic and we reward innovative thinking. We provide a multifaceted training program and hands\-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you! TTI is a place to explore your potential, where wins are celebrated, and your development is our priority. This is your opportunity to work with amazing people and support brands such as Milwaukee® and RYOBI®.

**Job Description**

The Milwaukee Tool brand is an industry leader, and our products are utilized by professionals across the country. We are looking for a **Graphic Designer Co****‑****op** to join our talented brand team and gain hands‑on experience supporting impactful creative work.


This role is designed for a student who is eager to learn, grow their design skills in a professional environment, and contribute creatively while developing a strong foundation in branding, production, and creative services. **The Graphic Designer Co****‑****op** will support the development and execution of design work across multiple touchpoints, helping bring our brand to life.


A successful candidate is passionate about design, curious, and motivated to create quality work while learning from experienced designers and cross‑functional partners.

**What You Will Do**

* Ensure consistency and adherence to Milwaukee Tool brand guidelines across assigned projects.
* Support the creation of visually appealing, on‑brand designs for a variety of mediums, including print collateral, digital assets, packaging, and promotional materials.
* Assist with the design and development of creative concepts, layouts, and visual assets for marketing materials such as digital ads, social media, web banners, presentations, brochures, and flyers.
* Collaborate with designers, marketers, and cross‑functional partners to understand project requirements and target audiences.
* Participate in brainstorming sessions and provide creative input while learning brand strategy and design problem‑solving.
* Support the review and proofreading of designs to ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality.
* Help maintain organized design files and assets and contribute to the company’s Digital Asset Management (DAM) platform.
* Assist with photo and video coordination for select projects as needed.
* Learn how to manage multiple small to mid‑scope projects in a fast‑paced environment with guidance and mentorship.
* Stay curious about trends in design, branding, marketing, and technology, and apply learnings to creative work.

**What You Will Bring**

* Currently enrolled in a College or University graphic design program
* Some experience with graphic design through coursework, internships, freelance work, or personal projects.
* A portfolio (student or personal work) that demonstrates creativity, visual design skills, and an understanding of design fundamentals.
* Proficient in Adobe Creative Cloud, including Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign; familiarity with After Effects or motion design tools is a plus.
* Solid foundational understanding of design principles, typography, layout, and color theory.
* Eager to learn, open to feedback, and motivated to improve craft and technical skills.
* Strong attention to detail and pride in producing thoughtful, polished work.
* Able to work collaboratively in a team environment and take direction effectively.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Organized, dependable, and interested in learning how design supports business and brand goals.
* Interest in working in a fast‑paced, real‑world design environment.
* Exposure to 3D rendering, animation, or photography is a bonus, but not required.

*TTI is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, where we celebrate, support, and thrive on diversity.*


Accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment process. If you require accommodations for interviews or other meetings, please advise when submitting your application.


**About TTI Canada**


TTI is a world\-class leader in design, manufacturing, and marketing of power tools, outdoor power equipment, and floorcare products, as well as hand tools and accessories. We cover a wide range of industries, and our customers vary from consumers to professionals. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus provides TTI with a platform for sustainable leadership and growth.


Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. We have partnered with some of Canada’s largest retailers to bring our customers brands such as *Milwaukee*®, *RYOBI*®, *Hoover*®, and *HART*®.

*Full\-Time \| Co\-op*

**TTI is where culture meets opportunity**. We are fast paced, highly energetic and we reward innovative thinking. TTI is a place to explore your potential, where wins are celebrated, and your development is our priority. This is your opportunity to work with amazing people and support brands such as Milwaukee® and RYOBI®.

**Job Description**

The Milwaukee Tool brand is an industry leader, and our products are utilized by professionals across the country. We are looking for a **Graphic Designer Co****‑****op** to join our talented brand team and gain hands‑on experience supporting impactful creative work.


This role is designed for a student who is eager to learn, grow their design skills in a professional environment, and contribute creatively while developing a strong foundation in branding, production, and creative services. **The Graphic Designer Co****‑****op** will support the development and execution of design work across multiple touchpoints, helping bring our brand to life.


A successful candidate is passionate about design, curious, and motivated to create quality work while learning from experienced designers and cross‑functional partners.

**What You Will Do**

* Ensure consistency and adherence to Milwaukee Tool brand guidelines across assigned projects.
* Support the creation of visually appealing, on‑brand designs for a variety of mediums, including print collateral, digital assets, packaging, and promotional materials.
* Assist with the design and development of creative concepts, layouts, and visual assets for marketing materials such as digital ads, social media, web banners, presentations, brochures, and flyers.
* Collaborate with designers, marketers, and cross‑functional partners to understand project requirements and target audiences.
* Participate in brainstorming sessions and provide creative input while learning brand strategy and design problem‑solving.
* Support the review and proofreading of designs to ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality.
* Help maintain organized design files and assets and contribute to the company’s Digital Asset Management (DAM) platform.
* Assist with photo and video coordination for select projects as needed.
* Learn how to manage multiple small to mid‑scope projects in a fast‑paced environment with guidance and mentorship.
* Stay curious about trends in design, branding, marketing, and technology, and apply learnings to creative work.

**What You Will Bring**

* Currently enrolled in a College or University graphic design program
* Some experience with graphic design through coursework, internships, freelance work, or personal projects.
* A portfolio (student or personal work) that demonstrates creativity, visual design skills, and an understanding of design fundamentals.
* Proficient in Adobe Creative Cloud, including Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign; familiarity with After Effects or motion design tools is a plus.
* Solid foundational understanding of design principles, typography, layout, and color theory.
* Eager to learn, open to feedback, and motivated to improve craft and technical skills.
* Strong attention to detail and pride in producing thoughtful, polished work.
* Able to work collaboratively in a team environment and take direction effectively.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Organized, dependable, and interested in learning how design supports business and brand goals.
* Interest in working in a fast‑paced, real‑world design environment.
* Exposure to 3D rendering, animation, or photography is a bonus, but not required.

*TTI is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, where we celebrate, support, and thrive on diversity.*

**Job Description**

The Milwaukee Tool brand is an industry leader, and our products are utilized by professionals across the country. We are looking for a **Graphic Designer Co****‑****op** to join our talented brand team and gain hands‑on experience supporting impactful creative work.


This role is designed for a student who is eager to learn, grow their design skills in a professional environment, and contribute creatively while developing a strong foundation in branding, production, and creative services. **The Graphic Designer Co****‑****op** will support the development and execution of design work across multiple touchpoints, helping bring our brand to life.


A successful candidate is passionate about design, curious, and motivated to create quality work while learning from experienced designers and cross‑functional partners.

**What You Will Do**

* Ensure consistency and adherence to Milwaukee Tool brand guidelines across assigned projects.
* Support the creation of visually appealing, on‑brand designs for a variety of mediums, including print collateral, digital assets, packaging, and promotional materials.
* Assist with the design and development of creative concepts, layouts, and visual assets for marketing materials such as digital ads, social media, web banners, presentations, brochures, and flyers.
* Collaborate with designers, marketers, and cross‑functional partners to understand project requirements and target audiences.
* Participate in brainstorming sessions and provide creative input while learning brand strategy and design problem‑solving.
* Support the review and proofreading of designs to ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality.
* Help maintain organized design files and assets and contribute to the company’s Digital Asset Management (DAM) platform.
* Assist with photo and video coordination for select projects as needed.
* Learn how to manage multiple small to mid‑scope projects in a fast‑paced environment with guidance and mentorship.
* Stay curious about trends in design, branding, marketing, and technology, and apply learnings to creative work.

**What You Will Bring**

* Currently enrolled in a College or University graphic design program
* Some experience with graphic design through coursework, internships, freelance work, or personal projects.
* A portfolio (student or personal work) that demonstrates creativity, visual design skills, and an understanding of design fundamentals.
* Proficient in Adobe Creative Cloud, including Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign; familiarity with After Effects or motion design tools is a plus.
* Solid foundational understanding of design principles, typography, layout, and color theory.
* Eager to learn, open to feedback, and motivated to improve craft and technical skills.
* Strong attention to detail and pride in producing thoughtful, polished work.
* Able to work collaboratively in a team environment and take direction effectively.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Organized, dependable, and interested in learning how design supports business and brand goals.
* Interest in working in a fast‑paced, real‑world design environment.
* Exposure to 3D rendering, animation, or photography is a bonus, but not required.
